formalized_statement.scope: Any two certified special framed-link presentations arising from handle decompositions of the same smooth, oriented, closed, connected four-manifold are connected by framed isotopy and the five reversible move families in Bärenz-Barrett Table 2.

references.title: Dichromatic State Sum Models for Four-Manifolds from Pivotal Functors

locators.label: connectivity premise and exact move table
locators.locator: paragraph immediately before Theorem 3.9 and Table 2, journal pages 685-686

references.source_reading: The article explicitly invokes the standard connectivity of handle decompositions by slides and cancellations, identifies the relevant link-diagram moves with Table 2, proves invariance under those five families, and concludes independence from the chosen special framed link.
references.interpretation_limit: The article supplies the accepted topology premise and evaluator-invariance proof in prose. Lean imports only the topology premise as a named domain axiom.

references.title: A link calculus for 4-manifolds
references.use_limit: Bibliographic support only; no standalone exact theorem is attributed to this source.

honesty.why_acceptable: The imported statement is the standard special Kirby-calculus completeness fact used explicitly in the proof of Bärenz-Barrett Theorem 3.9.
honesty.remaining_gap: A separate compiler must enrich every topology step with concrete handle-chain equivalences before R11 can use the movie.
